description: Bring-embedding magnitude probe (#4473 redirect, owner 2026-08-01, sharpened 'all geom embedded in Bring's and EVALUATED AT q₀'): does a Bring-genus-4 period / X5 weight of the w²(4₁, muon) vs w³(Borromean, proton) embeddings, evaluated at the substrate q₀≈1.10998, reproduce |S_proton/S_muon|≈4.075? HONEST NEGATIVE (a win). [A1] The observed magnitude is the anchor-offset ratio |(q_p−q*)/(q_m−q*)| where q* is the S-channel zero crossing (verified to 6 digits): S is hypersensitive (dS/dq≈3.8e6) and straddles a near-zero over the ~1.3e-8 muon-pin↔proton-pin q-gap — the muon anchor sits 2.5e-9 above q*, the proton 1.0e-8 below, and 4.075=1.0e-8/2.5e-9. This is q-anchor arithmetic, NOT a knot-embedding period. [A2] The X5/Z5 weight is categorical/unit-modulus ('categorical, not a morphism of curves … U(1) phase tube', x5-bring-weight-geometric-content.md): |ζ₅⁻³|/|ζ₅⁻²|=1, a phase not a magnitude. [A3] The SW periods a_D^(n) (sw-period-residue-sum.lean, jet-sw-tau-decomposition.lean) are abstract ℂ fields with no numeric realisation and jet degree≠winding power; the only FORCED numeric period of the two knots is the hyperbolic complex volume ratio 8G/(2·Cl₂(π/3))=3.610, q₀-independent, missing 4.075 by 11.4%; every q₀-evaluated boost candidate (sinh/cosh at ln q₀ or ln φ, φ^n, Lucas/Fib) misses by ≫0.1%. [A4] Structural wall: a q₀-evaluated period is smooth ⇒ its w³/w² value is identical at the two anchors to ~1e-9 (a factor≈1), so it cannot be a factor-4 hypersensitive ratio — the magnitude lives in the S near-zero crossing, not in any period (SP1 smoothness wall restated on Bring). No period adopted, no instance fabricated, no c_k wired; magnitude OPEN.

bring_embedding_magnitude_readout.missing_to_pin_a_period: a canonical HOMOLOGY CLASS / cycle on Bring's genus-4 Jacobian for each of w²(4₁) and w³(Borromean) — the corpus only guarantees EXISTENCE of the embedding via the genus bound g(K)≤4 (embeddability-closure.lean), not a specific period-carrying cycle; and a numeric realisation of the abstract SW periods a_D^(n). Without these, any period ratio requires a FREE choice of cycle/winding — the dense-fit resource the [D4] discipline forbids.
